srvSummary.message: I have my own Raf server (optional)

srvWhat.message:
A Raf server is a small app you run yourself with Docker — on a home server, a NAS or a cheap VPS. Connecting one adds:
  • video & audio downloads
  • a Telegram bot (save links, daily digest)
  • a web app for your phone
  • the same shelf on every device
No server? Skip this — nothing else needs it.

srvUrlHelp.message: Where your server is reachable, e.g. https://raf.example.com.

srvTokenHelp.message: The RAF_API_TOKEN you chose when you set up the server. It works like a password and is only ever sent to your own server. Tip: install the extension from your server's /extension.zip and both fields come pre-filled.

mailLabelQ.message: Want these emails to land in a “Raf” label in Gmail?

mailLabelA.message: Add +raf to your address (you+raf@gmail.com still reaches you). Then in Gmail: Settings → Filters → Create a new filter → To: you+raf@gmail.com → Apply the label “Raf” (and Skip the inbox if you like). Every Raf email is sorted automatically from then on.
